$comment: transcript.jsonl and its -crlf and -with-extra variants, read whole from a fresh cursor with history.jsonl naming the conversation's workspace and its presence lock held. Hand-written from 15 §5 (Antigravity row): person lines are USER_EXPLICIT/USER_INPUT content inside <USER_REQUEST>, dwarf lines are MODEL/PLANNER_RESPONSE content; a person line starts a turn, a step with tool calls and a GENERIC step are a record; SYSTEM_MESSAGE and ERROR_MESSAGE are the harness and yield nothing. No turn end (turnEnd none) and no usage in the step log.
